topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stumbled upon an online article today, and to my surprise, my college application essay was there, laid out for anyone to read. It felt like a private moment I shared with the admissions office was suddenly a public spectacle. I can’t help but think about all the eyes that might have skimmed over my words, the ones that poured out of me in quiet moments of reflection. I had chosen every phrase carefully, each one a piece of my heart. Now, it seems, those pieces are scattered across the internet. I'm not sure what to make of it. It’s a lot to process, and I'm left here, wondering what it all means.
